answers.question: I don’t know coding at all. Can I really build an AI product in this course?
answers.answer: Yes, you can start without coding experience. The course starts with AI, product, and development foundations before moving into building full-stack apps (both the screen and the backend database) and AI workflows. You will need to practise and build alongside the lessons. As you learn, you can also ask questions and contact Sahil in the Lapaas learner community. By the end, the course guides you to ship a deployed product that people can open on the internet.
